description: character melee combat animation and its supporting systems (attacks, impacts, hit reactions, combos) in Roblox

meanArtifact.name: generic click-swing
meanArtifact.description: a single canned attack animation that plays start-to-finish on click: no weighted wind-up, no hit-stop or freeze on contact, one fixed flinch reaction regardless of hit direction, the hitbox active for the whole swing (no marker-synced active frames), no combo or cancel windows, and the attack fully overrides movement -- what a beginner ships by default following a basic tutorial

greatArtifactHint: an award-quality action game's melee combat: weighted anticipation and follow-through with hit-stop/freeze-frames on impact, direction- and force-aware hit reactions and knockback, animation-marker-synced active frames driving hitboxes and impact SFX/VFX, cancelable combo strings with input buffering and timing windows, and attacks layered over locomotion so the character keeps moving
